snippet.title: D-topia | Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
D-topia is coming to PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox (X|S, Windows) on July 14, 2026.

In this gentle-paced puzzle adventure, it’s up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

A story about the future. A question about today. Where every choice matters.

Wishlist here: http://bit.ly/46sIxaR
